title: bests_down
description: Phone → watch. Each exercise's standing best — the numbers the phone's own "New PR" toast holds a set against, so the wrist can tell a record without holding any history. One frame, never batched, capped at 300 entries. Reference data: the phone owns the history, the watch reads it and never edits it.

bests.description: Every exercise the user has a completed set for, one entry each, ordered by exerciseId. An exercise with no completed set appears nowhere: an empty array is a frame like any other, telling the wrist the phone knows of no history.

bestEntry.description: One exercise's standing best. At least one axis is present — a floor the dialect cannot express as a schema constraint (no `anyOf`, and `oneOf` is exactly-one), so both validators enforce it as a semantic rule; a weighted best and a bodyweight rep best may travel together.

e1rmKg.description: The best estimated one-rep max, in kilograms, at the full precision the phone computes it — never rounded. Present only when the exercise has a set with load and reps; a zero estimate is refused as a semantic rule.

repsBest.description: The most reps in one set at zero load, a bodyweight set's best. Present only when the exercise has one.
